newsitem.title: POLAND: Prochnik falls along with parallel floor.
newsitem.headline: Prochnik falls along with parallel floor.

text.p: Shares in Polish garment maker Prochnik SA on Thursday extended Wednesday's tumble on concerns its bourse price may have been manipulated along with those of some parallel market firms, traders said.
Its shares fell 9.8 percent on Thursday to 21.1 zlotys.
On Tuesday the Securities Commission (KPW) notified the public prosecutor that a group of investors may have illegally manipulated prices.

This week's edition of weekly magazine Wprost wrote that a group of 20 investors from the western city of Poznan made more than 50 million zlotys during two years speculating on three firms on the parallel market. @
The parallel floor of smaller less liquid stocks fell 4.2 percent on Thursday and 3.1 percent on Wednesday.
Selling of Prochnik after price-fixing on Thursday was strong enough for players to have their bids reduced.
